  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The CI budget watcher job `budget-watch` is restricted to run only on pushes to `main`.
  WHY: A PR that increases the workflow size past the 430,000-byte contract-test ceiling will fail its final CI on the PR branch without ever having triggered the budget-watch issue. The source severity was MAJOR, mapped here to high.

  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The `budget-watch` job in `ci.yml` (line 5143 in the PR diff) is restricted to `github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'` and does not run as part of PR final CI. `budget-watch` is restricted to pushes to `main` and depends on the test jobs (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:5143-5153`). PR final CI runs via `workflow_dispatch` (`.github/workflows/ci.yml:22-28`), so a PR that takes a workflow from below 400,000 bytes to above the test ceiling gets no budget issue before its size test fails. Both reviewers rated it SEVERITY: MAJOR.

The current check-run context shows no failed checks, but `review / codex-agent` is still in progress and no completed merged-tree full-suite result exists for this PR's final head.
